_doc: Canonical constants for the Kalshi bot factory. Everything numeric that the backtester or the gate depends on lives here, so a value is never corrected in one module and left stale in another. Same role tuning.json plays for the game.
_UNVERIFIED: fees.taker_rate and the maker schedule are from general knowledge, NOT from a live read of Kalshi's fee schedule (this environment has no network access to kalshi.com). The fee formula is the single largest determinant of whether ANY strategy here is profitable. Re-read https://kalshi.com/docs/kalshi-fee-schedule.pdf and correct this file before trusting a single result. See kalshi/README.md 'What is unverified'.

fees.taker_formula: ceil_to_cent(rate * contracts * price * (1 - price)), price in dollars

microstructure._maker_fill_note: Probability a resting order at or inside the touch fills from uninformed flow in a step where price did NOT move through it. Pure guess. Market-making results are only as good as this number.

gate._doc: The definition of 'proven profit'. A bot must clear EVERY line to pass. Loosening any of these is how a bot factory lies to itself.

seeds._doc: Disjoint by construction. An episode drawn for in-sample can never appear in OOS or holdout, which is the only thing making the OOS number mean anything.
